Pet Adoption Fund is an all breed, 501(c)3, Non-Profit, No-Kill, Dog & Cat rescue and adoption organization since 1983, and it is located in the city of Canoga Park, Los Angeles county, CA. EIN# 95-3842460.

Visiting and Viewing our adoptable pets are by appointment only.  Please visit our website for more info. https://www.petadoptionfund.org

For more info on our ADOPTABLE pets, please call our shelter at (818) 340-1687 or (818) 340-1186. 

FOLLOW US on Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/petadoptionfund
FOLLOW US on X:                 https://X.com/petadoptionfund
FOLLOW US on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/petadoptionfundrescue

Kennel and Adoption Center Location:
7507 Deering Avenue - Canoga Park, California 91303
(818) 340-1687 or (818) 340-1186
Email: adopt@petadoptionfund.org or admin@petadoptionfund.org
